title: Area Theorems and Quasiconformal Extensions of Harmonic Mappings with a Pole
summary: In this paper, we study the class Σ_{H}^{k}(p) of sense-preserving univalent harmonic mappings in the unit disk \mathbb{D} that possess a simple pole at p\in[0,1) and admit a k-quasiconformal extension to the extended complex plane for k\in[0,1). In 2024, Bhowmik and Satpati established an area theorem and derived a sufficient condition for the k-quasiconformal extension of harmonic mappings belonging to Σ_{H}^{k}(p) without logarithmic terms.
